tools.name: search-markets
tools.description: Search for prediction markets with optional filters

contractType.description: Market/question type filter (default: ALL). Use contractType, not outcomeType.

creatorId.description: Optional. Creator (user) ID to filter by

sort.description: Sort order for market search (default: score). Do not use /markets sort values here.

tools.name: get-market
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific market

tools.name: get-bets
tools.description: Get bets from markets or for users with various filtering options

id.description: Optional. Bet ID to filter by

userId.description: Optional. User ID to filter by

contractId.description: Optional. Contract ID(s) to filter by

contractSlug.description: Optional. Contract slug to filter by

answerId.description: Optional. Answer ID to filter by

limit.description: Optional. Number of bets to return (default: 1000)

before.description: Optional. Get bets before this bet ID

after.description: Optional. Get bets after this bet ID

beforeTime.description: Optional. Get bets before this timestamp

afterTime.description: Optional. Get bets after this timestamp

order.description: Optional. Sort order by creation time

tools.name: search-users
tools.description: Search for users by username or display name

term.description: Search query for username or display name
